question: What does a no-selection buy-and-hold at the standard price return gross and net of eBay fees, by price tier and year?
method: Every card-month 2021-06..2026-09 with price>=10 and sales>=2; buy at max(price, 3-mo mean); sell at PC price h months later; net = sell*0.8589-5.20-buy
key_result: 1-mo P(net>0): 0.9% ($10-25) to 9.6% ($250-1000); 3-mo: 15-19% for $50+; 6-mo: 24-27%. Breakeven gross move 22% at $100, 28% at $50, 18% at $300. Nothing clears fees at 1-3 months without selection.

question: Which of 27 simple card-level signals separate forward winners from losers at 1/3/6 months? Does any top decile clear fees?
method: Monthly decile tables, equal-weighted months, 2022-01..; hit rate and t-stat of top-decile-minus-universe; monthly Spearman IC
key_metric: top/bottom decile gross vs universe; P(net>0)
key_result: Strong REVERSAL at every horizon: biggest 3/6/12-mo losers and cards furthest below their 6-12-mo mean win (dev12 bottom +9.0% vs universe +3.5% at 3 mo; +18% vs +11% at 6 mo); past winners lose (t -10 to -21). Set-level momentum weakly positive (hit 74% at 1 mo). Volume/volatility signals weak or negative. No top decile clears fees (best P(net>0) 9% at 1 mo, 20% at 3 mo).
verdict: worked as a map; nothing clears fees; set-level momentum later shown to be an averaging artifact (E11)

question: Inside the $50-500 band: is the reversal real (not estimator noise) and what does it pay by regime?
method: Decile tables with pmin 50 pmax 500; dev12 bottom decile split by this month's sales count (2-4/5-9/10-24/25+) and by regime (trailing 3-mo market move)
key_metric: bottom-decile gross/net/P(net>0) by sales group and regime
key_result: Reversal equally strong for 10-24-sale cards (+14.1% at 3 mo) as for 2-4-sale cards (+14.2%) -> real. Band 3-mo dev12 bottom: +10.5% gross, net -10.4%, P(net>0) 26%. Strong regime: +23.9% gross (net +1.1%, 40%); falling: +4.4%. 6-mo strong: +44% gross, net +18%, P(net>0) 62%.
verdict: worked; break-even at standard price at 3 mo, needs discount or 6 mo

question: Can PokeViews indicators or Google Trends forecast the next 1-3 months of the market better than its own trailing move?
method: Monthly merged table; lead/lag Spearman; OLS of next-1/3-mo market median move on AR term + one candidate, Newey-West t, leave-one-year-out R2; daily PV250 indicator quintiles vs forward 30/60/90-day index return
data: E01 market series; pokeviews feeds; google_trends
key_metric: OOS R2 gain over AR-only; sign accuracy
key_result: Regime persistence extreme: P(next month market median>0 | this>0)=0.89, P(>0 | this<=0)=0.07; AR(1) of trailing-3 = 0.96. Google web-search 1-month change adds to the AR term (next-3-mo OOS R2 0.60->0.66, HAC t 8.7; next-1-mo 0.60->0.64, t 3.9). PokeViews HCI/MMS/highs-lows/trend-extension/RSI: no incremental value on 29-31 months. Daily: distance above SMA200 mean-reverts at 90 days (Spearman -0.75) but ~9 independent windows.
verdict: worked: regime sign + Trends change; PV indicators not additive (short sample)

question: Calendar seasonality and the set-age curve inside the band
method: Median monthly market move by calendar month raw and de-trended by year; forward returns by set-age bucket and regime
key_metric: de-trended mean by month; gross/net by age bucket
key_result: Seasonality second-order: Mar (+1.3%, 6/6 years) and Apr strongest, Jun-Sep weakest; the year/regime explains ~10x more variance. Set age: <12 months lose 10-25% in 3 months in every regime; 12-23 months break-even; >=24 months flat-to-positive; in the 2025-26 boom 4-year-plus sets led (+15-16% in 3 mo).
verdict: worked as filters (age>=24 mo); not a ranking signal

question: Does walk-forward gradient boosting beat the simple reversal rule at 1-3 months? Do exogenous market features help the ranking?
method: HistGradientBoostingRegressor, refit every 6 months on months <= t-h, scored 2022-12..2026-09; feature sets A card-only, B +Trends/breadth/calendar, C without short momentum; permutation importance
key_metric: IC; top-decile gross/net/P(net>0); P(net>0 at 20% off)
key_result: IC 0.27 (positive every month) at 1 and 3 mo. Top decile 1-mo +5.7% gross (band -0.3%), net -15%, P(net>0) 14%; 3-mo +11.7% (band +5.2%), net -10%, 27%; at 20% off P(net>0) 61-63%. Exogenous features add nothing to the ranking (IC 0.275 vs 0.272). At 6 mo in strong regimes the top decile equals the band (ranking adds nothing). 3-mo top decile is about equal to the plain dev12 bottom decile.
verdict: worked (ranks) but does not beat the simple rule; exogenous features fail inside the ranking

question: ML variants aimed at the objective: band-only training; classifiers for net>0 at standard price and at 20% off; calibration
method: Same walk-forward; D_band regression in 50-500; E_cls classifier (net>0 standard); G_cls20 classifier (net>0 bought 20% under); calibration bins
key_metric: top-decile realised P(net>0 at 20% off); calibration
key_result: D_band IC 0.22-0.23, top decile 3-mo +11.3%. E_cls badly over-confident at the top (pred 0.5-0.7 -> realised 0.33 at 3 mo). G_cls20 well calibrated at 1 mo (0.45->0.50, 0.65->0.64, 0.74->0.73), mildly over-confident at the top at 3 mo; top decile realised P(net>0 at 20% off) 66-68% (75-77% in strong regimes).
verdict: worked: G_cls20 is a usable calibrated chance for discounted buys; raw standard-price classifier probabilities must not be shown

question: How much of the fee wall can eBay execution recover: floor discounts, patient-sell premium, sale-price dispersion, eBay median vs PriceCharting?
method: eBay Catalog snapshot 2026-10-23 (L/A floor discount, s80/smed, edays, n30) and daily rollup individual sale prices vs the card's 7-day median
key_metric: share of cards/sales at >=10/15/20% under the median
key_result: Credible floor >=20% under the sold median on ~12% of cards (>=15%: 25%; >=10%: 40%); 5.6% of individual sales print >=20% below the 7-day median, 20% print >=10% below; patient-sell premium (s80/smed) +9-11%. eBay sold median = PriceCharting price for $50+ cards (ratio 0.98-1.03); PC runs 14% low at $25-50 and ~50% low at $10-25.
verdict: worked: execution edge quantified (~20-25% both legs combined), PC sell level validated for $50+

question: How do P(net>0) and mean net change under alternative fee structures and buy discounts, holding realised returns fixed?
method: Realised 1/3-mo returns (band; dev12-bottom-strong) under 7 sell-side cost structures x 5 buy discounts
key_result: Each point of buy discount ~1.3 points of net. dev12-bottom-strong 3-mo: standard price net -0.9%/38%; 20% under +23.8%/72%; +buyer pays shipping +29.6%/80%; store rate adds ~1 point; zero-fee +52%/95%. Whole band 3-mo at 20% under: +9.1%/58%.
verdict: worked: levers ranked - discount > shipping passed to buyer > store rate > any signal beyond reversal

question: Buying the dip at the dipped print (price_t) instead of the standard price: what does the reversal pay when the buy is realistic?
method: Band quintiles of dev3/dev12/mom1 by sales count; buy at standard / print / halfway; 1 and 3 months; by regime
key_result: Bottom quintile dev12 (10+ sales) bought at the print: 1-mo +10.3% gross (vs +1.1% at standard), net -11%, P(net>0) 21%; 3-mo +19.0% gross, net -3.6%, 37%; strong regime 3-mo +23.4%, net +0.4%, 43%. The print sits only 8-12% under the standard price.
verdict: worked: 1-month reversal is real at a realistic buy; fees still win at 1 month

question: Reinvesting flipper simulation 2022-01..2026-09: hold x rule x gate x discount x capital, with fees, 20%/card cap, liquidity cap, realistic discount availability
method: Non-overlapping cycles, all start offsets averaged; rules dev12/dev12f/mom12/combo/setmom/random/top_mom3; gates none/reg3>0/reg3>2%; discounts 0/10/15/20%; availability 12%/25%/40% with 1-2 copies, averaged over 5 seeded draws; $2k/$5k/$10k
key_metric: final capital, CAGR, P(losing cycle), worst cycle, max drawdown, by year
key_result: Standard price: all rules lose at every hold ungated ($5k->$724 at 3 mo); gated 3-6 mo +6-12%/yr with ~half the cycles losing. 20% under, 12% availability, 1 copy, 3-mo dev12 (mean of 5 draws): $5k->$17.4k (+31%/yr, 30% losing cycles, DD -18%); gated reg3>0: $15.6k (+28%/yr, 0 losing cycles, trades 39% of the time). 15% under: dev12 +22%/yr ungated, +20% gated (2% losing); random -3%. 10% under: only gated 3-mo clearly positive (+16%/yr). 1-mo needs 20% under (+28% ungated with DD -42%, +36% gated; 15% under loses). By year: 2022 -12%/yr (3-mo) and -32% (1-mo) even at 20% under; 2024-26 +45 to +155%/yr. Chasing winners worst everywhere; E16 filters do not help.
verdict: worked: 3-mo hold x deep reversal x age>=24 x >=15-20% under x regime gate; failed: standard price, 10% ungated, 1-mo at 15%, momentum chasing

question: Does PokeViews' daily set index give a timelier set-momentum signal than PriceCharting's monthly set move?
method: Month-end PV set-index trailing 30/90-day returns mapped to PC sets vs next-month PC card returns (set- and card-level IC, quintiles); then the clean test: set index trailing return vs its OWN forward 30/90-day return from the daily series
key_result: Against PC monthly returns the PV signal looks strong (set IC 0.49, positive 28/28 months; top-quintile sets +6.0% vs bottom -3.6% next month) but against its OWN daily forward returns there is nothing (IC -0.04, positive 40% of months). The apparent power is the monthly-averaging artifact (a set rising late in the month carries its end-of-month level into next month's average). E02's set_mom1 'momentum' is the same artifact.
verdict: failed as a signal; worked as a lesson (set momentum is not real; PC monthly averaging inflates momentum-type signals)

question: How correlated are the reversal picks, how much does diversification buy, and which hold compounds fastest at each discount?
method: Variance decomposition of pick returns into month mean and residual; random baskets n=1..40; mean net by hold (1/2/3/6) x discount x regime converted to a per-month rate
universe: dev12 bottom decile, price 50-500, sales>=2, age>=24 mo
key_metric: basket std and P(loss) by n; net per month of capital
key_result: Market month explains only 3% (1-mo) / 6% (3-mo) of pick variance (pair correlation 0.03-0.06): 3-mo basket P(loss) 40% (1 card) -> 15% (20 cards) -> 10% (40). At 1 mo P(loss) floors at ~42% whatever n. Per month of capital, gated (reg3>0): 20% under 1-mo 6.6%, 2-mo 7.2%, 3-mo 6.9%, 6-mo 6.1% (0 losing months at 2-3 mo); 15% under 0.3%/4.0%/4.7%/5.0%; 10% under -5.2%/1.0%/2.7%/4.0%; 0% -14.7%/-4.2%/-0.8%/+2.2%.
verdict: worked: hold 2-3 months with >=20 cards at >=15% under; 6 months only for near-standard buys; 1-month holds need 20% under

question: At the eBay weekly scale: is there reversal, and are deep floors adversely selected?
method: Daily rollup: 7-day sold median change past week vs next week (Spearman per day, quintiles); cheapest_ask/median bins vs the median's next 7/14-day change
key_metric: Spearman; forward median change by ask/median bin
key_result: Weekly reversal: Spearman -0.15, negative 9/10 days; week's top risers -5.5% next week, fallers -0.6% vs all -2.5%. Deep floors (ask <0.8x median): median -1.4% over 7 d, -4.0% over 14 d vs +2.1%/+1.3% for asks at 0.9-1.0x -> mild adverse selection, leaves ~15 pts of a 20% discount.
verdict: suggestive only (26 days); rerun at >=90 days

question: Which regime gate definition is best: reg1>0, reg3>0, reg3>2%, AR+Trends forecast, PV250 30-day return?
method: Sign accuracy of each gate's call on the next-3-month market move 2022-01..2026-06; the E10 simulation with each gate
data: E01 market series; google_trends; pokeviews top250; pricecharting panel
key_metric: sign accuracy; sim CAGR and losing cycles
key_result: reg3>0: on 40% of months, next quarter +6.9% when on vs -2.5% off, sign accuracy 91%, sim $5k->$17.2k (30%/yr, 0 losing cycles) vs ungated $16.7k (29%, 33% losing). reg1>0 similar (91%). reg3>2% accuracy 75%, halves wealth. AR+Trends gate 88% on 40 months, no better. PV250 gate only 27 months, untested through a down-cycle.
verdict: worked: reg3>0 (reg1>0 as fast confirm); Trends do not improve the gate

question: What does the reversal rule actually buy (tier, age, sales, rarity, set), is it concentrated, and do simple filters help?
method: Composition of dev12-bottom-decile picks 2022-2026 with 3-month outcomes at 20% under; dev12f rule (sales>=5, no Promo set) in the E10 simulation
key_metric: share of picks and P(net20>0) by group
key_result: 65% of picks are 15y+ vintage sets (Skyridge 10%, Base Set 8%), 57% are $50-100. P(net20>0): $250-500 77% > $100-250 71% > $50-100 63%; sales 10-24 72% vs 2-4 60%; Promo set 55% (weakest). Max single-set share per month 17% on average. But the sales>=5/no-Promo filters do NOT improve the simulated portfolio (equal or 5-15% lower final wealth) - fewer candidates, and thin vintage cards' higher gross offsets their lower hit rate.
verdict: worked (composition sane, vintage-heavy); filters did not help at portfolio level
